Method of Attack: Malware injected into cryptocurrency trading applications to steal cryptocurrency
Delivered as apparently benign apps via attacker-controlled sites mimicking legitimate cryptocurrency trading sites and companies
Initial infection vectors include phishing, social networking, and social engineering techniques
Indicators of Compromise: Seven malware analysis reports (MAR-10322463-1.v1 to MAR-10322463-7.v1) with IOCs released by CISA
